scientific_protocol: Complete 5 original coarse starts, three released and two tube. Select the lowest finite stage score independently in each group. Run all three original 4, 8 and 16 interval refinements on each winner for 11 stages. Each stage jointly solves every positive phase coefficient with two complete L-BFGS-B blocks, scans fresh physical normal-chord pairs after each block and validates the original finite chart, rim, seam and normal overlap on the independent spatial and temporal grids. On the same worker export for each of the two final points the union of all final validation phases and seven original world-mesh phases.

The exact stage NPZ identity remains independent. The R759 held-head world frame applies throughout.
